import sys
from functools import reduce
from operator import and_, or_, xor

ops = {'&': and_, '|': or_, '^': xor}
n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
commands = [sys.stdin.readline().split() for _ in range(n)]
result = reduce(lambda acc, cmd: ops[cmd[0]](acc, int(cmd[1])), commands, 0)

if result == 0 and all(op == '&' for op, _ in commands):
    print(0)
else:
    print(1)
    if result == 0:
        print('& 0')
    else:
        mask_and = reduce(and_, (int(x) for op, x in commands if op == '&'), 1023)
        mask_or = reduce(or_, (int(x) for op, x in commands if op == '|'), 0)
        mask_xor = reduce(xor, (int(x) for op, x in commands if op == '^'), 0)
        final_mask = mask_and | mask_or ^ mask_xor
        print('|', final_mask)
